entries.text: kit/kit.lock pins 157 components with a pending list of 9 theme entries: 32 tier core plus 125 tier conditional, governed by mcp_cap 8.
The 112 locked components group by kind as skill 26, mcp 8, lsp 1, hook 7, agent 6, and cli 64.
registry/catalog.json is the generated machine mirror holding 2804 components: skill 1504, mcp 907, plugin 11, hook 20, agent 284, formatting 13, lsp 1, cli 64.
Registry sidecars live under registry/data as eight JSONL files (agents, cli, formatting, hooks, lsp, mcp, plugins, skills) plus overlaps.yaml for supersedes and pairs_with relations.
On disk .opencode/skills holds 21 skill folders, .opencode/agents holds 10 agent definitions, and docs holds 18 numbered files from 00-INDEX.md through 17-V2-HOOK-GAP.md.

At most 8 MCP servers sit in the kit set: filesystem, fetch, memory, sequential-thinking, github, context7, firecrawl, and openrouter; phase scoping keeps context spend near the work and the cap stops the worst case.
